full_prompt_en: A square layered folk-art illustration sets a small cream chapel deep inside an ornamental grove against a nearly black night background. The chapel sits slightly right of center, its front steps leading to a narrow reddish doorway under a triangular pediment. A low bell tower with a tiled pointed roof rises above it. The building is carefully simplified into flat ivory and gray planes, with small dark windows and a few fine carved details. To its left, a large tree dominates the composition: a dark trunk and many thin branching limbs spread across round, overlapping crimson and coral canopies. Similar but smaller red and pink trees crowd the right and lower edges. Behind all of them, scalloped charcoal and muted green-gray hill or leaf shapes stack in shallow layers, with scattered tiny circular glints tucked into the darkness. A pale bird with rust-colored wings crosses the upper right, giving the still setting one moving accent. Rounded leaf clusters in olive, blue-gray, dusty peach, and rose fill the bottom foreground like cut and embossed paper. The composition is densely framed, but the pale chapel and its stairway remain an open visual center. The surface has the dimensional softness of layered paper or low-relief painting: rounded forms carry subtle inner shading, stippled grain, and thin etched veins while their silhouettes stay clean. Most color lies in deep charcoal, slate green, and warm muted red; cream is used sparingly at the center. Light is soft and internal, as though the pale building and a few small spots glow against the black without casting long shadows. The image feels secretive and gently enchanted, its ordered little center protected by luxuriant dark foliage.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形层叠民间艺术插画在近黑夜色前，把一座小奶油色教堂安放在装饰性树林深处。教堂略偏右，正面台阶通向三角门楣下的狭窄红色入口。上面升起一座低钟塔和瓦片尖顶。建筑被谨慎简化为平面象牙白与灰色块，带小深窗和少量精细雕饰。左侧一棵大树主导构图：深树干与许多细分枝铺过圆浑、重叠的绯红和珊瑚色树冠。类似但更小的红粉树挤在右侧和下缘。所有树后面，扇贝边的炭色与暗绿灰山形或叶形层层叠起，黑暗中藏着零散小圆亮点。一只浅色、带锈色翅膀的鸟飞过右上，为静止环境带来一处运动点缀。橄榄绿、蓝灰、灰桃和玫瑰色圆叶团像剪贴、压凸的纸片填满下方前景。构图框围密集，但浅色教堂与台阶仍是开放视觉中心。表面有分层纸或低浮雕绘画的立体柔软感：圆浑形体带细微内部明暗、点状颗粒和纤刻叶脉，剪影仍干净。多数色彩落在深炭、石板绿与暗暖红中，奶油色只在中央少量使用。光柔和且像从内部发出，浅建筑和少数小点在黑底前发亮，却不投长影。图像隐秘而温柔奇幻，秩序井然的小中心被丰茂深色枝叶保护。
style_prompt_en: A layered folk-art illustration uses cut-paper-like silhouettes and low-relief shading against a nearly black square field. Large rounded crimson and coral masses overlap on one side, while smaller dusty pink and olive clusters echo them around a sparse pale center. Thin dark branching lines, tiny circles, delicate vein cuts, and stippled grain animate the broad color shapes without making them messy. Dark charcoal and slate green take up most of the area; warm red is concentrated in distinct clustered islands, and cream appears as a compact focal relief. Shapes stack vertically and laterally in shallow depth rather than receding through strict perspective. Edges remain clean and slightly embossed, with gentle inner gradients suggesting layered paper thickness. Illumination is low and diffuse, giving select pale surfaces a contained glow while leaving the broad dark ground intact. The visual rhythm is dense at the margins but opens briefly at the center, producing an enclosed, secretive, decorative mood.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠民间艺术插画在近黑方形底上使用剪纸般剪影与低浮雕式阴影。一侧大型绯红与珊瑚色圆浑体块叠压，较小灰粉与橄榄绿簇群在稀疏浅色中心周围呼应。细暗分枝线、小圆点、精细叶脉刻痕和点状颗粒活跃宽阔色形，却不使之杂乱。深炭与石板绿占据大部分面积；暖红集中为分明簇岛，奶油色作为紧凑焦点浮雕。形状在浅纵深中纵横叠放，而非由严格透视后退。边缘干净且略有压凸感，温和内部渐变暗示纸层厚度。照明低而漫射，让选定浅色表面有包裹式微光，宽阔深底保持完整。视觉节奏在边缘密集，中央短暂打开，形成围合、隐秘、装饰性的气氛。
theme_en: A small pale chapel nestled among red and charcoal stylized trees at night
theme_zh: 夜晚一座浅色小教堂藏在红与炭色的风格化树木间
name: Jane Burch Cochran
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
